comments.value: YES PLEASE! SOMEONE MAKE A QUEST VERSION OF HIM AN SUBMIT IT TO THE TEAM!! We need our custom man! Who else will carry out the legacy if Nikei is gone. :(

Would also like to add that this canny is for having him on the official public listing, not for anyone to just upload a Quest copy to a world.

details: I beleive that Nikei is a staple of the VRC brand, and it's honestly a big disappointment that new users coming into the app wont be able to experience this incredible avatar. Please make him available in the public listing for quest users.
title: Port Nikei to Quest.
